guitar.evidence: Jake Kiszka is well known for playing vintage Gibson Les Pauls and SGs in a Page/Hendrix-inspired style.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with medium confidence (well known, but not one singular iconic instrument).

tone.target: vintage blues-rock crunch with wah-tinged edge and raw upper mids
tone.profile: vintage blues-rock crunch with wah-tinged edge and raw upper mids
tone.summary: A classic blues-rock chain utilizing a Boost for initial grit, followed by a Distortion model to achieve thick crunch, shaped by a Wah pedal, and delivered through the UK 45 amp simulation with vintage cabinet coloration.
corrections: lean more vintage crunch than high-gain

rig.name: Greta Van Fleet - Safari Song - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and sustain noise.
Add initial grit and push the signal into the distortion stage.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for subtle pre-drive rather than a dedicated OD pedal, as per vintage blues tone requirement.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core thick crunch and raw bite.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is chosen to emulate a Plexi/Vox style breakup rather than modern metal gain.

blocks.purpose: Introduce the required wah texture and vocal edge.
Enhance the raw upper mids and overall vintage bite.
blocks.gap: Used to manually dial in the 'raw 70s bite' that might be missing from the core distortion model.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic British Plexi/Vox sound profile.
Provide the classic British cabinet coloration and punch.
Add subtle depth and sustain to the leads without sounding modern.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to add dimension, avoiding a distracting effect that would clash with the raw vintage tone.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic echo for sustained leads.
blocks.gap: Kept minimal to support the blues-rock feel without becoming overly ambient.

blocks.purpose: Give the tone a sense of space and vintage room ambiance.
blocks.gap: A subtle Room reverb is preferred over Plate/Spring to maintain the raw, live feel.

improvements.summary: Upgrade cabinet realism for better vintage punch.

proposals.reason: Enhance raw upper mids and Plexi bite.
